template_data.lead_html: A prospect brings up OASIS+. Here's how I run that call.

rows.what_html: Set-aside status? — no cert + no past performance means OASIS+ unrestricted is a dead end for most small businesses
What industry? — OASIS+ is professional services only; products, construction, staffing don't fit
What do you want to bid? — most land on GSA MAS: 12M+ offerings, no revenue floor, open to new entrants

template_data.closer: THE VEHICLE FOLLOWS YOUR BUSINESS. NOT THE REVERSE.
